newsitem.title: UK: Princess Diana dress catalogue costs 1,250 pounds.
newsitem.headline: Princess Diana dress catalogue costs 1,250 pounds.

text.p: The luxury catalogue for next month's charity sale of Princess Diana's dresses is to go on sale for 1,250 pounds ($2,050).
Buyers of the purple, leather-bound volume will get the autograph of one of the world's most photographed women along with colour pictures of the 80 outfits up for sale in New York on June 25.
Christies the auctioneers said 250 limited editions of the catalogue were available with specially-posed photographs of the princess by Lord Snowdon.
The auction, originally suggested by Diana's son Prince William, is expected to raise about four million pounds for AIDS and cancer charities.
